You project your data onto these new axes to get a simplified representation. The math can be daunting, but the goal is to reduce clutter and find patterns without losing much information.","According to you, how can LLMs be used to innovate math learning in schools and universities?":"LLMs can personalize math instruction by adapting to each student’s pace and style.
